Ride far. Carry stuff. Have fun.
strings.이베이전을 날렵하게 다듬은 그래블 프레임: A sharper, lighter Evasion built for gravel
strings.두 조각으로 나뉘어 비행기에 오르는 미니벨로: A mini velo that splits in two and flies with you
strings.혼다 트레일 바이크에서 출발한 스텝스루 이베이전: A step-thru Evasion inspired by the Honda Trail
strings.크러스트 바이크(Crust Bikes)는 호주 시드니 출신의 매트 화이트: Crust Bikes is an American steel bicycle brand started by Matt Whitehead, a Sydney native. A plumber by trade, he fell for bike touring on a long ride through Mexico. Riding in Nepal on a bike that needed fixing at every turn, he decided to build a better touring bike himself. Emails with frame factories in Taiwan followed, and the first Crust, the Evasion, was born.
strings.뉴저지 벨마에서 출발한 크러스트는 이후 버지니아 리치먼드로 터전을 옮겨,: Crust started in Belmar, New Jersey, then moved to Richmond, Virginia, where Matt runs it as a small team with his wife, Cheech. It is a brand that puts the joy of riding and creative freedom ahead of industry trends and growth.
strings.대만 장인의 TIG 용접 수작업: TIG welded by hand in Taiwan
strings.소량 생산, 컬러는 런마다 다르게: Small batches, new colors every run
strings.크러스트의 모든 프레임은 짐을 싣고 멀리 달리는 여행에서 출발합니다. 랙: Every Crust frame starts from loaded, long-distance travel. That is why they come with braze-ons for racks, fenders and cages wherever they make sense.
strings.열처리 크로몰리를 TIG 용접하고 ED 코팅으로 안팎을 보호합니다. 부드: Heat-treated chromoly, TIG welded and ED coated inside and out. Steel smooths the road, lasts for years and can be repaired when the day comes.
strings.사이즈 하나, 타이어 하나까지 솔직하게 안내하고, 맞지 않는 용도는 맞지: Crust is straight with you about every size and every tire, and tells you plainly when a frame is not made for something. Built seriously, ridden for fun.
strings.네팔에서 손볼 곳투성이인 자전거를 타며, 매트는 이보다 나은 투어링 바이: Riding a bike in Nepal that needed fixing everywhere, Matt figured he could build a better touring bike himself.
strings.매트 화이트헤드가 처음 그린 자전거는 산악자전거처럼 여유 있는 지오메트리: His first design was a touring frame with relaxed, mountain-bike-like geometry and room for very wide tires, because it had to keep going, loaded, after the pavement ended. That idea became the Evasion, which found a following fast as bikepacking grew into a genre of its own.
strings.이후 크러스트는 그래블 봄보라, 분리형 미니벨로 스투피드 투어리스트, 스: Since then Crust has released small runs of frames that each exist for a clear reason: the Bombora for gravel, the Stupid Tourist travel mini velo that splits in two, and the step-thru Evasion Trail 140. Celos, Crust's own carbon division, came from the same thinking.
A long ride through Mexico turns into a love of touring and bikepacking.
On a trip in Nepal, Matt contacts Taiwanese frame makers and designs his first frame.
The Evasion arrives: a touring frame with fat tires and mountain bike geometry.
Crust moves from Belmar, New Jersey to Hull Street in Richmond, Virginia.
Crust framesets officially imported to Korea by Rubi Company.
strings.크러스트의 시작. 어디든 짐을 싣고 가는 올라운드 투어링·어드벤처 프레임: Where Crust began. An all-round touring and adventure frame that takes your gear anywhere.
strings.이베이전 리어에 길고 낮은 스텝스루 프론트를 더한 플랫바 어드벤처 바이크: An Evasion rear end with a long, low step-thru front. A flat-bar adventure bike.
strings.이베이전을 가볍고 날렵하게 다듬은 플러스 타이어 그래블 프레임. 카본 포: A lighter, sportier Evasion for plus-size gravel tires. Also available as the Celos Bombora with a carbon fork.
A 20-inch touring mini velo that splits in two with the Ritchey Breakaway system.
strings.이베이전(Evasion)은 크러스트가 처음 만든 프레임이자 지금도 브랜드: The Evasion was the first Crust frame and is still at the heart of the brand: an all-round touring and adventure frame. It is designed to fit big tires and still ride well, with enough braze-ons to take it around the world.
strings.26x3인치 타이어를 기준으로 설계해 모래와 자갈, 진흙길에서도 여유가: Designed around 26x3" tires, it stays composed on sand, gravel and mud. It also takes 27.5" up to 2.8" and 29" up to 2.0", so you can swap wheels for the trip and the season.
strings.26x3인치까지 들어가는 클리어런스. 공기압을 낮춰 짐을 실은 채로도 거: Clearance for 26x3" tires. Run low pressure and roll over rough ground comfortably, even fully loaded.
strings.조절식 로커 드롭아웃으로 로놀프 허브나 싱글스피드도 깔끔하게 구성할 수: Adjustable rocker dropouts make Rohloff hubs and single speed setups clean. Slotted dropouts are recommended for Rohloff.
strings.랙, 펜더, 보틀 케이지, 포크 카고 마운트까지. 여행 장비를 원하는 대: Racks, fenders, bottle cages and fork cargo mounts. Plenty of mounts to carry your gear the way you want.
strings.73mm BSA 바텀브라켓에 MTB 크랭크를 씁니다. 체인링 40T 이하: A 73mm BSA bottom bracket with a mountain crank. 1x with a 40T or smaller chainring is recommended.
strings.오렌지 & 그레이 스페클 블루러그 스페셜 에디션 · 갤럭시 블랙: Orange & Gray Speckle Blue Lug Special Edition · Galaxy Black
strings.열처리 크로몰리, TIG 용접, ED 코팅 (대만 수작업): Heat-treated chromoly, TIG welded, ED coated (handmade in Taiwan)
strings.조절식 로커 드롭아웃 (로놀프 · 싱글스피드 대응): Adjustable rocker dropouts (Rohloff and single speed compatible)
strings.앞뒤 IS 마운트, 로터 최대 앞 203mm / 뒤 180mm: IS mounts front and rear, max rotor 203mm front / 180mm rear
strings.73mm BSA, MTB 크랭크 (1x 40T 이하 권장): 73mm BSA, mountain crank (1x, 40T or smaller recommended)
strings.오렌지 & 그레이 스페클 블루러그 스페셜 에디션 / 갤럭시 블랙: Orange & Gray Speckle Blue Lug Special Edition / Galaxy Black
strings.크러스트는 이베이전을 한 사이즈 크게 고르는 것을 권장합니다. 정확한 사: Crust recommends sizing up on the Evasion. Rubi Workshop can confirm your size with a fitting consultation.
strings.이베이전의 리어 트라이앵글에 길고 낮은 스텝스루 프론트를 결합한 파생 모: A spin-off that pairs the Evasion rear triangle with a long, low step-thru front end. It is designed for flat, riser, alt or townie bars instead of drop bars, and the only standards change from the Evasion is Boost spacing front and rear.
strings.우체부 바이크에서 온 자전거: A bicycle from the postie bike
strings.매트 화이트헤드는 혼다의 트레일 90·110, 이른바 '포스티 바이크'를: Matt has long loved Honda's Trail 90 and 110, the 'postie bikes'. The Evasion Trail 140 brings the attitude of that little motorcycle, loaded up and happy to head down any road, to a bicycle.
strings.낮은 스텝스루 탑튜브로 짐을 가득 실은 상태에서도 타고 내리기 쉽고, 긴: The low step-thru top tube makes it easy to get on and off even when fully loaded, and the long reach with upright bars gives a wide view ahead. Designed around 26x3", it also takes 27.5x2.8" and 29x2.0".
strings.권장 신장은 참고용입니다. 드로퍼 포스트를 쓰지 않는다면 한 사이즈 크게: Rider heights are a guide only. Unless you plan to run a dropper post, consider sizing up.
strings.봄보라(Bombora)는 크러스트가 그래블 바이크라고 부르는 스틸 프레임: The Bombora is the steel frame Crust calls its gravel bike. It keeps the Evasion's character but takes a road crank in a 68mm BSA shell, swaps the rocker dropouts for simple 12mm thru-axle dropouts, and uses a lighter tube set for less weight and a smoother ride.
strings.650B 2.3인치 타이어를 기준으로 설계했고 700C는 48mm까지 들: It is designed around 650B x 2.3" tires and fits 700C up to 48mm. Rack and fender braze-ons stay, so one bike covers commuting, touring and weekend gravel.
strings.650B 2.3인치의 넉넉한 공기량으로 비포장 임도와 자갈길을 부드럽게: The big air volume of 650B x 2.3" tires smooths out dirt roads and gravel.
strings.68mm BSA에 로드 크랭크를 씁니다. 1x 44T 이하를 권장하고,: A road crank in a 68mm BSA shell. 1x with 44T or smaller is recommended, and 2x is possible.
strings.이베이전보다 가벼운 튜브로 무게를 줄이고 스틸 특유의 부드러운 승차감을: Lighter tubing than the Evasion saves weight and brings out the smooth ride of steel.
strings.크러스트는 봄보라를 산악자전거가 아니라고 분명히 말합니다. 거친 싱글트랙: Crust is clear that the Bombora is not a mountain bike. Rough singletrack and rocky trails are Evasion territory.
strings.블루러그(Blue Lug) 스페셜 에디션 컬러입니다. 크러스트는 생산 런: A Blue Lug Special Edition color. Crust often changes colors from run to run, so each batch of Bombora has its own look.
strings.2025년 런부터는 브라스 케이블 가이드가 적용되어 디테일이 한층 단정해: From the 2025 run, brass cable guides tidy up the details. Colors in stock in Korea vary, so please ask Rubi Workshop.
strings.셀로스(Celos)는 크러스트의 카본 디비전입니다. 셀로스 봄보라는 봄보: Celos is Crust's carbon division. The Celos Bombora pairs the Bombora frame with a Celos carbon fork and steps up the frame details.
strings.셀로스 포크는 가는 블레이드에 1-1/8\" 스트레이트 스티어러를 쓴 5: The Celos fork is a 545g carbon fork with slim blades and a straight 1-1/8" steerer. It has clearance for 2.3 to 2.4" tires, three-pack mounts rated to 3kg per leg, internal routing for brake and dynamo, and fender mounts. Crust says it rides no stiffer than the stock steel fork.
strings.프레임에는 볼트 체결식 브라스 다운튜브 케이블 가이드, 체인스테이 루프: The frame adds bolt-on brass down tube cable guides, loop guides on the chainstays, a Shaka integrated seat clamp and IS42 integrated headset cups. Sizes now run up to XXL 62.
strings.크로몰리 포크, A to C 395mm, 스티어러 400mm: Chromoly fork, 395mm axle to crown, 400mm steerer
strings.앞뒤 플랫 마운트, 로터 최대 앞 180mm / 뒤 160mm: Flat mount front and rear, max rotor 180mm front / 160mm rear
strings.68mm BSA, 로드 크랭크 (1x 44T 이하 권장): 68mm BSA, road crank (1x, 44T or smaller recommended)
strings.터쿼이즈 마블 블루러그 스페셜 에디션 / 파스텔 바이올렛: Turquoise Marble Blue Lug Special Edition / Pastel Violet
strings.열처리 크로몰리, TIG 용접 (대만 수작업), 브라스 케이블 가이드,: Heat-treated chromoly, TIG welded (handmade in Taiwan), brass cable guides, Shaka integrated seat clamp
strings.셀로스 카본 포크 545g, 1-1/8\" 스트레이트 스티어러 350mm: Celos carbon fork 545g, straight 1-1/8" steerer 350mm, three-pack mounts (3kg per leg), internal routing, fender mounts
strings.앞뒤 플랫 마운트, 로터 최대 160mm: Flat mount front and rear, max rotor 160mm
strings.셀로스 카본 포크에는 프론트 랙 사용을 권장하지 않습니다. 스템 아래 스: A front rack is not recommended on the Celos carbon fork. Keep spacers under the stem to 40mm or less.
strings.단위 mm, 각도 ° · XXL은 셀로스 봄보라 전용: Millimeters and degrees · XXL is Celos Bombora only
strings.스투피드 투어리스트(Stupid Tourist)는 리치 브레이크어웨이(R: The Stupid Tourist is a touring mini velo built around the Ritchey Breakaway system. Undo the couplers on the down tube and seat tube and the frame comes apart in two, ready to pack with its 20-inch wheels into an airline-size case.
strings.작은 휠은 짐의 무게중심을 낮추고, 크게 설계한 프론트 트라이앵글은 대형: Small wheels keep the load low, and the big front triangle holds a large frame bag. With room for up to 20x2.6" tires, run them wide off road and slick in the city.
strings.커플러 두 개만 풀면 두 조각. 여행지에서 렌트 대신 내 자전거로 달릴: Undo two couplers and it is in two pieces. Ride your own bike on the trip instead of a rental.
strings.캔틸레버·V브레이크의 림 버전과 IS 마운트 디스크 버전 중에서 고릅니다: Choose the rim version for cantilever or V-brakes, or the disc version with IS mounts.
strings.디스크 버전은 로커 드롭아웃과 분할 시트스테이로 싱글스피드와 벨트 드라이: The disc version has rocker dropouts and a split seatstay for single speed and belt drive.
strings.BMX 타이어가 들어가지만 프레임이 분리되는 구조입니다. 계단 같은 충격: It fits BMX tires, but the frame comes apart. Please skip the stair drops.
strings.열처리 크로몰리, TIG 용접 (대만 수작업), 리치 브레이크어웨이 분리: Heat-treated chromoly, TIG welded (handmade in Taiwan), Ritchey Breakaway split frame
strings.27.2mm, 드로퍼 내부 라우팅 (350~400mm 길이 필요): 27.2mm, internal dropper routing (350 to 400mm post needed)
strings.볼트 체결 프레임백용 추가 보스: Extra bosses for a bolt-on frame bag
strings.IS 마운트, 로터 앞뒤 160mm 권장: IS mounts, 160mm rotors front and rear recommended
strings.로커 드롭아웃 (싱글스피드), 분할 시트스테이 (벨트 드라이브): Rocker dropouts (single speed), split seatstay (belt drive)
strings.유압 디스크 브레이크를 쓸 때는 분리를 고려해 호스 길이와 라우팅을 계획: With hydraulic disc brakes, plan hose length and routing so the frame can still come apart. Rubi Workshop can help you choose a packing case and parts.
strings.크러스트는 자신들의 프레임에 맞춰 직접 설계한 부품도 만듭니다. 어떤 자: Crust also designs parts around its own frames. A fork that turns almost any bike into a cargo bike, short and tall stems for riders who sized up: each one solves a specific problem. All are chromoly, TIG welded in Taiwan.
strings.바구니·박스용 볼트 홀 6개: Six bolt holes for a basket or crate
strings.스택이 낮은 프레임의 바 높이를 올릴 때: Raises the bars on low-stack frames
strings.클리어 마감 스템은 시간이 지나며 도장 아래 거미줄 모양의 녹 패티나가: Clear-finish stems may develop a spidery rust patina under the coat over time. It is cosmetic only.
strings.크러스트는 프레임셋으로 들어옵니다. 어디를 어떻게 달리고 무엇을 싣고 싶: Crust comes to Korea as framesets. Tell us where and how you ride and what you want to carry. Rubi Workshop will help you choose the model and size, then build it up with wheels, drivetrain, racks and bags for your kind of trip.
strings.루비컴퍼니는 크러스트 바이크의 한국 공식 수입원입니다. 크러스트 프레임셋: Rubi Company is the official importer of Crust Bikes in Korea. Bike shops that want to stock Crust framesets and parts can contact Rubi Supply.

strings.열처리 크로몰리 투어링·어드벤처 프레임. 26x3인치, 27.5x2.8인: Heat-treated chromoly touring and adventure frame for 26x3" and 27.5x2.8" tires, with rocker dropouts for Rohloff or single speed.
strings.이베이전을 날렵하게 다듬은 그래블 프레임. 650B 2.3인치, 700C: A sportier Evasion for gravel: 650B x 2.3" or 700C x 48mm tires, 68mm BSA road crank.
strings.크로몰리 그래블 프레임셋 · 카본 포크: Chromoly gravel frameset with carbon fork
strings.셀로스 카본 포크(545g)와 인테그레이티드 헤드셋, 브라스 케이블 가이: The Bombora with a 545g Celos carbon fork, integrated headset and brass cable guides.
strings.리치 브레이크어웨이 방식으로 두 조각으로 나뉘는 20인치 투어링 미니벨로: A 20-inch touring mini velo that splits in two with the Ritchey Breakaway system. Rim and disc versions.
